name: Omarchy Spaces
author: Samy Lemcelli
description: Context spaces for Omarchy. Each space owns its browser profile, email, assistant accounts, workspaces, appearance, and notification policy.

barWidget.description: Place it twice: once in indicator mode for the active space, once in workspaces mode for numbers scoped to that space.
